name: Asset Include
description: This component allows you to embed an external content asset or a chromeless Page Designer page.

attribute_definitions.name: Asset ID
attribute_definitions.description: Enter an ID for either a content asset or a Page Designer page that has been set to 'chromeless' in the page attributes tab of Page Settings.

attribute_definitions.name: Container class
attribute_definitions.description: Class(es) to add to this component's container for spacing, alignment, etc.

attribute_definitions.name: Filter by Querystring
attribute_definitions.description: Enable this to show assets depending on the current URL parameters. For example, if this is on a PLP refined by the color pink, it will check for your Asset ID plus '-pink' (or '-Pink') and show that. If none is found, it will fall back to the Asset ID you entered above.

attribute_definitions.name: Additional Params
attribute_definitions.description: (Standard content assets only) If you need to pass additional params besides the Asset ID, enter them here in JSON format as follows: {"key1": "value1", "key2": "value2"}.

attribute_definitions.name: Link to Asset
attribute_definitions.description: Copy the link below to view the included asset in a new tab. This will work for Page Designer pages, but not for content assets.
